note: Submodule of entity_hierarchy. Defines the entity_hierarchy_microsite content entity (fields name, home [entity_reference to landing node], generate_menu [bool], logo [media]) managed at /admin/structure/entity-hierarchy-microsites (route entity.entity_hierarchy_microsite.collection, permission 'administer entity hierarchy microsites'). Provides blocks entity_hierarchy_microsite_menu and entity_hierarchy_microsite_branding, condition entity_hierarchy_microsite_child, a cache context, and the ChildOfMicrositeLookup service. Medium introspects a created Microsite entity; hard creates a Microsite entity pointing at a given home node, verified against live entities.

evals.prompt: In Entity Hierarchy Microsites, what is a 'microsite' and which field determines the section of the tree it covers? Where do you manage microsites in the admin UI?
evals.expected_output: A microsite is an entity_hierarchy_microsite entity whose 'home' field points at a landing node; the microsite covers that node and its hierarchy descendants. Manage them at /admin/structure/entity-hierarchy-microsites.

evals.prompt: Which blocks and block visibility condition does Entity Hierarchy Microsites provide for building a section's navigation and scoping blocks to that section?
evals.expected_output: Blocks entity_hierarchy_microsite_menu (section menu) and entity_hierarchy_microsite_branding (logo), plus the block visibility condition entity_hierarchy_microsite_child ('is a child of a microsite').

evals.prompt: How does Entity Hierarchy Microsites build a microsite's navigation menu, and where can you override individual generated menu items?
evals.expected_output: When generate_menu is TRUE it auto-derives links for the home node and its descendants into the entity-hierarchy-microsite menu; individual items are overridden via eh_microsite_menu_override entities (so regeneration doesn't clobber them).

evals.prompt: On this site a microsite (entity_hierarchy_microsite entity) has been configured. Inspect the live entities and give the microsite's name and the title of its home/landing node.
evals.expected_output: The microsite is 'EHM Known Site' and its home node is the Article titled 'EHM Home Node' (load the entity_hierarchy_microsite entity and follow its home reference).

evals.prompt: On this site there is an Article titled 'EHM Task Home'. Using Entity Hierarchy Microsites, create a microsite named 'EHM Task Site' whose home/landing page is that node, and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a Microsite entity: Microsite::create(['name' => 'EHM Task Site', 'home' => ['target_id' => <EHM Task Home nid>]])->save(). verify confirms a microsite named 'EHM Task Site' exists with home pointing at the EHM Task Home node.
